parameters.query:
WITH c AS (
  UPDATE leads l
  SET status = 'cold', updated_at = now()
  FROM segment_playbook p
  WHERE p.segment = l.segment
    AND l.status = 'contacted'
    AND l.next_action_at <= now()
    AND l.followup_count >= p.max_followups
    AND (l.last_inbound_at IS NULL OR l.last_inbound_at < l.last_outbound_at)
  RETURNING l.id
)
INSERT INTO lead_events (lead_id, event_type)
SELECT id, 'marked_cold' FROM c
RETURNING id;

SELECT l.id AS lead_id, l.first_name, l.segment, l.service_interest,
       l.channel_pref AS channel, l.followup_count,
       p.angle, p.max_followups, c.business_name, c.sender_name,
       (SELECT body FROM messages m
        WHERE m.lead_id = l.id AND m.direction = 'outbound'
        ORDER BY m.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_message
FROM leads l
JOIN segment_playbook p ON p.segment = l.segment
CROSS JOIN campaign_settings c
WHERE c.is_active
  AND l.status = 'contacted'
  AND NOT l.opted_out AND NOT l.ai_paused
  AND l.next_action_at <= now()
  AND l.followup_count < p.max_followups
  AND (l.last_inbound_at IS NULL OR l.last_inbound_at < l.last_outbound_at)
  AND extract(hour FROM now() AT TIME ZONE l.timezone) >= c.send_start_hour
  AND extract(hour FROM now() AT TIME ZONE l.timezone) <  c.send_end_hour
ORDER BY l.next_action_at
LIMIT 1;

parameters.text: =(They have not replied. Write follow-up message number {{ $json.followup_count + 1 }}.)

parameters.query:
WITH m AS (
  INSERT INTO messages (lead_id, channel, direction, body, ai_generated)
  VALUES ($1::uuid, $3::text, 'outbound', $2::text, true)
  RETURNING id
), e AS (
  INSERT INTO lead_events (lead_id, event_type, payload)
  VALUES ($1::uuid, 'followup_sent', jsonb_build_object('followup_number', $5::int + 1))
  RETURNING id
)
UPDATE leads
SET followup_count = followup_count + 1,
    last_outbound_at = now(),
    next_action_at = now() + make_interval(days => coalesce(
        (SELECT followup_days[$5::int + 2] FROM segment_playbook WHERE segment = $4::text), 5)),
    updated_at = now()
WHERE id = $1::uuid
RETURNING id, $2::text AS followup, followup_count;
